title: Predator Activity Near Coop and Pasture
dataSources: Beehive telemetry (`beehive:reading`), coop door (`chickencoop:door`), egg counts (`egg:count`), livestock tags (`livestock:tag`), feed level (`feed:level`), pasture sensors (`pasture:sensor`).
app: Homestead sensors — connected beehive scale/temperature/sound, automatic chicken-coop door, egg counter, livestock GPS/health tags, feed-silo level, and pasture soil sensors — streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and LoRaWAN gateways.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trailcam:detection (label=fox OR label=coyote OR label=raccoon OR label=hawk)
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as sightings by label _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts predator sightings from trail cameras around the coop and pasture, revealing when and what is casing your animals.
value: Predators scout before they strike; knowing which species appear and when lets you reinforce defences before you lose stock.
implementation: Feed trail-camera detections into `index=personal`; schedule daily and review predator activity by species.
visualization: Column chart of predator sightings by species over time.
grandmaExplanation: It counts foxes and other predators your cameras spot near the animals, so you can protect them before an attack.
